## M1 Arc 1.0.1

- Fixed accidental menu shortcut assignment during startup: Capture and Save are now explicit.
- Added Ctrl, Shift, and Ctrl + Shift combinations for the menu shortcut.
- Added Ctrl + Shift + F11 emergency recovery to reopen menu shortcut setup.
- Existing saved shortcuts remain compatible; no settings reset required.
- Added a distinct typography hierarchy, information-card tooltips, and redesigned shortcut selection dialog.
- Improved mouse wheel handling for independently scrollable panels; the mod list has a fixed header and count with an overflow scrollbar.
- Redesigned notification cards with stacked status and wrapped message text.
- Connected notifications to saved settings, shortcut changes, language changes and queued mod actions.
- Added a header switch for per-mod session logs, clipboard export, clear confirmation and opt-in REDscript diagnostic logging.
- Added shareable diagnostic reports with detected file versions, selected mod settings, pending actions, startup failures and specific framework error reasons.
- Updated English, Polish and Korean interface text.

**Requirements:** Cyberpunk 2077 2.50, RED4ext and REDscript.

Close the game, extract the game-root ZIP into the Cyberpunk 2077 folder and overwrite existing files. Keep settings.json.

[Documentation](https://m1nsook.github.io/m1arc/) · [Nexus Mods](https://www.nexusmods.com/cyberpunk2077/mods/39311)
